measurement_environment.released_source: v0.6.1 rebuilt with same Go toolchain

v061.layer: wrapped decrypted Driver.Read with exact-length validation

baseline.layer: wrapped decrypted Driver.Read with exact-length validation

limitations: Uncached direct reads bypass all VFS read cache and OS file cache but do not exercise interactive stage planning. Old releases use Driver.Read because they have no ReadSource API.
Mounted cold runs clear Qrypt caches before every seek and use macOS F_NOCACHE; in-memory hot chunks can still coalesce reads inside a sample. They are not zero-cache reads.
The before-policy control is rebuilt with identical probe range-traversal repair via a local Go overlay; policy matches the pre-tuning implementation.

The first uncached candidate round was run before the remaining interleaved rounds; its startup outlier is retained. Direct/mounted first runs briefly overlapped; no speedup claim is made from that overlap.
Bounded diagnostic rings omit early events, so retained request/byte/concurrency counts cannot establish total amplification.
These durations measure reading a full 1MiB, not player decode/render or network first-byte latency.
No continuous download or three-backend acceptance was completed.
